bio.text: Carrie Buck, a Republican, has represented District 5 in the Nevada Senate since 2020 and is her party's candidate for Nevada's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is president of the Pinecrest Foundation education nonprofit and was previously a teacher and principal before leading a charter school network.

According to the Nevada Legislature, she holds a doctorate in organizational leadership from Nova Southeastern University (2006), a master's in administration and supervision from the University of Phoenix (1998) and a bachelor's in elementary education from Montana State University (1995).
